name: IHH Healthcare Berhad
overview: 今年 IHH 完成两家子公司的自愿清算（Suzhou Industrial Park Yuan Hui Health Consulting 与 Parkway Life Malaysia），属于业务精简动作；其余公告主要为季度业绩、股息、董事会委员会人事变动及诉讼事项，未披露新增业务线或重大合约。
overview_en: During the year, IHH completed the voluntary liquidation of two subsidiaries (Suzhou Industrial Park Yuan Hui Health Consulting and Parkway Life Malaysia), a streamlining action; other announcements were mainly quarterly results, dividends, board committee changes and litigation matters, with no new business lines or major contracts disclosed.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成两家子公司的自愿清算，属于业务精简；其余公告为业绩、股息及公司治理事项。
segments.note_en: Completed voluntary liquidation of two subsidiaries during the year as a streamlining move; other announcements were results, dividends and corporate governance matters.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: Suzhou Industrial Park Yuan Hui Health Consulting Co., Ltd. 的清算已完成，并于 2026 年 8 月 7 日注销。
actions.text_en: The liquidation of Suzhou Industrial Park Yuan Hui Health Consulting Co., Ltd. was completed and the company was de-registered effective 7 August 2026.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 宣布 Suzhou Industrial Park Yuan Hui Health Consulting Co., Ltd. 进行自愿清算。
actions.text_en: Announced the voluntary liquidation of Suzhou Industrial Park Yuan Hui Health Consulting Co., Ltd.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 启动 Parkway Life Malaysia Sdn Bhd 的成员自愿清盘。
actions.text_en: Commenced the member's voluntary winding up of Parkway Life Malaysia Sdn Bhd.
